description: Get details about a YouTube video without its transcript: title, description, channel, publish date, duration, view and like counts, tags, category and chapters. Accepts a video URL or an 11-character video ID. Use it to check what a video is, or how long it is, before fetching the transcript. If you need the transcript too, call get_transcript with include_video_info=true instead.

video.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID

name: get_video_info
title: Get YouTube video info
